root.label: CAF strips Senegal of AFCON title and awards Morocco 3-0

events.label: CAF strips Senegal of AFCON title and awards Morocco 3-0

slots.name: final score
slots.sentence: However, they were stripped of the title two months later after CAF's Appeal Board ruled that Senegal had forfeited the match by walking off the pitch, overturning the result and awarding a 3-0 victory to Morocco.

events.label: Senegal lodges CAS appeal over AFCON title

slots.name: appeal filing date
slots.sentence: Senegal quickly followed with an appeal to sport’s highest court, CAS, which was lodged on March 25 but heard on Thursday.

events.label: CAS hears Senegal appeal over AFCON title

slots.name: hearing date
slots.sentence: “After the hearing, the panel will start its deliberations. At this stage, CAS cannot state when a final decision will be rendered but it will not be on the date of the hearing,” CAS said in a statement.

slots.name: panel members
slots.sentence: The CAS panel, presided over by French sports law expert Gerald Simon with assistance from Italian international law professor Luigi Fumagalli and Hamburg-based lawyer and professor of law at the University of Zurich Ulrich Haas, heard the pleadings of the parties who were represented by their lawyers, with the hearing completed on Thursday.
